group.description: Multi-value entry index (0-based); ties a value to its label or parts

two_factor_enabled.description: Always false here; GET /users/me/2fa says whether two-factor is on

existing_deleted.description: The matched contact is in the trash

label.description: The relationship type or the activity title

recovery_code.description: Second step: a recovery code, in place of the code

totp_code.description: Second step for accounts with two-factor: an authenticator code

totp_required.description: True when the password was right and the second step is still due

contact_id.description: Ignored when the note is added under /contacts/{id}/notes. On update, leaving it out keeps the current contact.

provider_name.description: A display name for the provider, present when enabled

photo.description: The stored name of the new photo, empty when the contact has none

by_mail.description: Send it by e-mail. Leaving it out keeps the current value.

contact_id.description: Required; when the reminder is added under /contacts/{id}/reminders the contact of the URL wins.

remind_at.description: Only the day counts; the time of day is dropped.

reoccur_from_completion.description: Count the next occurrence from completion. Leaving it out keeps the current value.

reminder.description: Absent when a once reminder was finished and deleted

duplicate_match.description: The existing contact this row matches, null when none

warnings.description: Values dropped so the row can import

reason.description: skipped (chosen in the preview), invalid or failed

purge_at.description: When the automatic purge removes it

otpauth_uri.description: For the QR code the authenticator app scans

available.description: False for accounts without a password (single sign-on only)

secret.description: Signs every payload; it cannot be read again
